relevance_note: A systematic review of Danon disease that, besides group statistics, gives individual-level details for a few previously published patients, e.g. 'The fifth male patient carried a Trp321Arg missense mutation common to all isoforms^21', and one unpublished registry patient.
method_note: Rows built with a short Python script in the scratch directory from my own reading; every span checked verbatim against the paper by script. This is a narrative/systematic review; most data are group-level (percentages, counts, means) and give no rows. Supplemental Tables 1 and 2 (68 mutations, incl. 6 unpublished registry mutations) are not in the converted text (the 'Supplementary Material' section is empty), so no per-mutation rows. Individuals given rows: previously published persons with at least one individual-level fact (refs 18/20, 21, 19, 26, 33, 34) and one unpublished registry patient ('unnamed person 1', 38-year-old male, source 'un-published data', so source_reference_in_review = not reported). Left out as group/count-only mentions: the four male patients of the c.1150 G>C family (ref 18; only 'four of these five male patients' with a mean onset), the Italian family with 'four of six affected women' (no individual detail beyond counts), Thiadens et al. male patients (ref 20), and the epidemiology counts. The female carrier (ref 18 patient) is tied to c.1150 G>C only through 'a single female carrier in this family' where the family's mutation is c.1150 G>C; zygosity not stated. Ref 21 patient: 'leading to classic findings at age 21' recorded as age at onset because the paragraph is about age of symptom onset; 'classic findings' not recorded as a feature (too vague). Trp321Arg printed without 'p.' prefix, recorded in protein field as printed. Ref 26 patient: deceased inferred only from 'at autopsy'; age at death not explicitly stated so deceased_age left null, '14-year old' put in last evaluation. Ref 19 patient: 'obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy' used for checklist LVH and LVOT obstruction; 'marked vacuolar myopathy on muscle biopsy' (histology) not used for the clinical item 'proximal muscle weakness (skeletal myopathy)'. Citation-only attributions not used: 'attention deficit,^33', 'behavioral problems,^25, 33', 'maculopathy,^34', and the c.928G>A sentence citing ^19 (not tied to the 4-month-old patient). is_proband left null for review persons. No stacked cells; tables 1-2 are differential/treatment tables with no patients. No contradictions found.
